subtitles.text: The story begins in a small kingdom.
Here, our hero Will lives.
His neighbor is named Eldran, and he has taken care of him since he was little.
There's a letter on the table... What might it contain?
So... the star has finally awakened.
The first step is complete...
Will arrives with the fruit box.
Suddenly, he senses something.
A fireball is heading towards them.
Will closes his eyes and unknowingly unleashes powerful magic.
And a fireball shoots from his hands, completely deflecting the projectile.
Will is confused about what just happened when suddenly...
The ground trembles and a dark figure emerges amid smoke and fire: a demon.
Will! Use your magic, press <sprite name="interactable_x"> and defeat the demon!
How interesting!
The demon's attack has awakened your magic.
Will! Use it against the demon, press <sprite name="interactable_x"> and defeat him.
Will, watch out!
Take that!
No... this can't be!
What... what was that?
Will, get out of the way!
That's it, Will! You've got this!
Come on, boy! I know you can do it!
Don't give up! Finish it once and for all!
The spiders thought they had cornered a helpless prey. They didn't know they had just locked themselves in with Estela.
With a defiant smile, Estela unleashed her true power.
With a mischievous wink and a satisfied grin, Estela looked upon her work. Not a single spider was left standing.
ESTELA: Out of my way!
ESTELA: Spiders? How disappointing.
ESTELA: Take that!
ESTELA: You have no idea who you're dealing with.
ESTELA: There goes the last one!
That's for being ugly.
Oh, didn't see that coming?
Poor little thing.
You're sooo boring...

Oh nooo, please... someone help me!
...these two big strong muscular warriors...
...are going to rob a helpless little princess like me...
...Was that it?
Piece of cake!
That fool is going to ruin my plans...
LIAM: Let's see if she's as strong as they say...
Estela: Hmph. Just as I predicted. The explosion trajectory was perfect.
Estela: I had it all calculated.
Will: Calculated? You tripped before shooting! Just admit it...
Will: It was a miracle we didn't end up as mush.
Liam (from the shadows): That sorceress is an unforeseen problem in my equation.
Liam: The Golem has failed. If I want the boy to reach the end, I'll have to guide him myself.
So… that's the pure-hearted boy who will open the Path.
I'm glad that demon managed to awaken his magic.
Ha… ha ha…
Let's see if this golem is enough...
If not... I'll have to step in myself.
Nobody interrupts me while I'm eating!
So take this!
RUUUUUN!!!

The first time I cast a spell, I nearly singed my own eyebrows off.
And look at me now... an actual prodigy.
Fear isn't the problem, kiddo.
The problem would be if you stopped trying. And I'm not letting that happen.
Will... what's wrong?

You won't be facing this alone.
Whatever happens.

It's the first time I've ever left home.
My whole life has been back there.
I'm scared, Liam. What if I can't control this?
What if out there, what I am just isn't enough... and it all goes wrong?
...Thank you. Okay. Let's go.

We need to find out who summoned that demon, and now a golem too...
And why they're after you.
I think I've lost my appetite.
Yes, yes, very insightful. And when is the food coming?
That... wasn't me.
FINALLY!
NOBODY interrupts me when I'm eating!
This guy's going to get it!

Pardon the interruption...
My name is Liam, and I couldn't help overhearing your conversation.
I think I have information that might interest you.
And what it has to do with my magic...
Estela... do you really eat like that?
WHAT?!
Eldran, Will, and Estela discuss what happened and try to find a solution...
When suddenly, Estela's stomach growled ferociously.
The food finally arrives, and our heroes prepare to eat.
Estela does it in a rather... unique way...
Eldran and Will, shocked by Estela's eating manners, lose their appetite.
At that moment, Liam approaches, having eavesdropped on the conversation from afar.
He tries to tell the group something, but catches the attention of Estela, who could only think about food at that moment.
Furious about the interruption, Estela conjures a fireball.
The three of them are caught completely off guard...
Run! Flee from Estela until her anger blows over!
Spiders, attack!
Piece of cake? Let's see if our technique is that easy to handle...
Little princess? More like little ugly, don't you think?
Hand over everything you've got and we won't hurt you.
Good grief...
Did you see that, Estela? Now a golem! This has never happened before... Run, let's get back to Eldran!
